rationale.consistency: Uses FlagErrorf, heredoc, ghinstance/gh conventions; but ships a testing.go importing `testing` in a production package, reuses PRRepository for Issue, and plumbs Config ad hoc per command.
rationale.edge_cases: Validates size, type, dir/non-regular/empty, dup via SameFile, video alt, code spans, ref defs; but a mid-batch upload failure still writes a partial body (spec: nothing written) and default alt strips extension rather than using file name.
rationale.scope: Focused on the feature, but leaves dead code: unused isSingleImage, unused UploadStub type, StubUploadToHost's unused t param; extra databaseId added to several existing queries.
rationale.readability: client.go repeats the same uploadError construction five times; attach.go's argIdx walk to map ToAppend back to assets is convoluted; references.go is 600 lines of hand-rolled byte scanning beside goldmark.
rationale.robustness: Files/responses closed, nil-safe Flag receiver, mutex around shared error; but partial uploads are committed and reported as error, and params["body"].(string) is an unchecked assertion.
rationale.maintainability: Uploader construction plus token-type lookup duplicated across six commands; hasDeferredEdits duplicates hasDeferredFlags; attachAssetsToMarkdown re-parses via newAttachableMarkdown; uploadError fields unused.
